description: Change an uptime check's settings. Only the fields you pass are changed; list fields (tags, contact_groups, regions, dns_ips) are REPLACED, and an empty list clears them. Pass paused=true to pause a check and paused=false to resume it. StatusCake: PUT /uptime/{test_id}.

basic_password.description: HTTP basic-auth password for the target.

basic_username.description: HTTP basic-auth username for the target.

confirmation.description: Number of confirmation servers that must agree before alerting, 0-3 (default 2).

contact_groups.description: Contact group ids to alert (see statuscake_list_contact_groups). An empty list clears them.

custom_header.description: JSON object string of headers to send, e.g. {"X-Env":"prod"}.

dns_ips.description: IP addresses the DNS record must resolve to (DNS checks).

do_not_find.description: Invert find_string: the check is down if the string IS present.

enable_ssl_alert.description: Alert when the site's SSL certificate is about to expire.

final_endpoint.description: Where the redirect chain should end (with follow_redirects).

find_string.description: String to look for in the response; the check is down if not found.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects when testing (off by default).

include_header.description: Include response headers in the find_string search.

paused.description: true to pause the check (stops running and alerting), false to resume.

post_body.description: JSON object string submitted with the request; setting it makes the check use HTTP POST.

post_raw.description: Raw HTTP POST body to send.

regions.description: Region codes to run the check from (see statuscake_list_uptime_locations).

status_codes_csv.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes that count as down, e.g. "500,502,503".

tags.description: Tags for the check. An empty list clears them.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the first byte, 5-75 (default 15).

trigger_rate.description: Minutes to wait before sending an alert, 0-60 (default 0).

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent sent with each check.

website_url.description: New URL, FQDN or IP address to check.

name: statuscake_update_uptime_check
title: Update an uptime check
